_about: WOKING GT3 (McLaren 720S GT3): the race display on the column is a blank quad of the interior's material (its UVs on one dark patch of the texture), so it gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): a digital race cluster in McLaren orange. Its steering wheel's two side grips, left in the body by the model's cut, are moved onto the wheel (wheel_parts).
